fields.name: to
fields.description: The map to go to. In a map of the Cave of Many Dreams: the next floor, or `main` to leave the cave.

fields.name: s
fields.coerce: `s || 0`. A door compares it with loose `==` to `door[5] || 0`, so `"1"` matches 1. The Transporter compares it with strict `===` to `G.npcs.transporter.places[to]`, so a string fails with `transport_cant_reach`. A cave door uses strict `===` (node/logic/generated_maps.js:158)
fields.description: The spawn on the destination map. It must match the spawn of the door or the spawn of the Transporter list (`winterland` 1, `main` 9, `desertland` 1, `cyberland` 0).

responses.name: Moved
responses.when: A normal move: all checks pass. The server first lowers by 5,200 ms the time of each condition that is not a debuff and has less than 60,000 ms left (`decay_s`; a `citizens` aura also has its numbers divided by 4). A `player` update follows.

responses.name: Bank pending
responses.when: Bank entry: the destination has `mount` and you are not in a bank. Bank exit: you are in a bank and the destination has no `mount`. The server adds 32 call-cost (entry) or 16 (exit) and starts a database transaction; the move comes later. For a `ulocked` bank map entered from outside the bank, this reply comes after a database read of the unlock flag.

fields.name: success
fields.description: Always `false`: the move did not happen yet.

responses.name: Bank done
responses.when: Later: the bank transaction succeeded. Then two `player` updates follow: one from the move, then a full one (`resend(player)`). After an entry, the second has `user`: your bank packs `items0` to `items47`, `gold`, `rewards`, `unlocked`.

responses.name: Cave door
responses.when: You are in a map of the Cave of Many Dreams (checked after `transport_failed`). A different handler, `generated_use_door`, does the move; it is asynchronous. `map` is the new floor. A door to `main` leaves the cave: you get `cave` `{type: "ended", reason: "exit"}`, `new_map` and `player` first, and the reply has `exited: true` in place of `map`.

fields.name: map
fields.description: The floor that you moved to.

fields.name: exited
fields.description: You left the cave through a door to `main`.

rows.when: You cannot walk (`can_walk`: dead, `stunned`, `fingered`, `stoned`, `deepfreezed`, `sleeping`, or `dash`), or you are in `jail`.

Cave map: the door failed. `reason` is the message of the error. `use_exit`: you cannot walk or are dead, or `to` is not a floor of the run. `cave_closed`: the run ended or you left it. `cave_paused`: a conversation pauses the run. `transport_cant_reach`: no door to `to` with spawn `s` is near you. `seal_closed`: the current floor is not complete. `transport_failed`: the move failed after the server built the floor. Another error gives its own message.
`to` is not a map, it has no instance, its instance does not allow entry (`allow`), or it is a cave map (`generated_can_enter`).
You use the Transporter (or you are a GM, or in `woffice` on a `hardcore` server) and you have the `dampened` condition.

No door to `to` with spawn `s` is within `B.door_dist` (112 px) of you. And no Transporter of your map within `B.transporter_dist` (160 px) lists `to` with spawn `s`. GMs, and characters in `woffice` on a `hardcore` server, skip this check.
The door is `protected`, and a gatekeeper monster is alive in your instance.
You are in a bank (`player.user`), the door is `ulocked` into a bank map, and your account did not unlock that map.
Bank entry or exit: a bank entry or exit of this character runs already.
Bank entry through a `ulocked` door from outside the bank: a read of the unlock flag for an earlier `transport` runs already.
Bank entry through a `ulocked` door from outside the bank: the database says that your account did not unlock that map. This reply comes after the read.
Bank entry through a `ulocked` door: after the read, your character left, is in a bank, or a bank operation started. Also any error in the read.
Later: the bank entry transaction failed. You stay where you are. The object has no `place` and no `failed`.

extra.name: name
extra.description: Only for `already_in_bank`: the id of the character that holds the bank now (`owner.mounted_to`). `null` if the account record is missing (`owner && owner.mounted_to`).

extra.name: reason
extra.description: `character_gone`: the session of your character changed. `already_in_bank`: another character of the account (or another server) has the bank. `exception`: a database error, after up to 6 tries.

confirm.note: If the account record is missing, `already_in_bank` sends `name: null` (`owner && owner.mounted_to`)

rows.when: Later: the bank exit transaction failed (`not_in_game` or `bank_owner_lost`, after up to 3 tries). The server sends nothing and disconnects the socket.

also.when: A move (now, or later for the bank): clients that saw you at the old position.
also.summary: `{id, reason: "transport", to, s}`. `to` and `s` are absent when you are invisible or `stealth`, or when the instance name is not a map name. See the `leave` entry for the fields.
Your character (`u+cid`) on the new map.

Normal move: `disappear` to clients near your old position
Bank entry or exit: `game_response` `data` with `in_progress: true` to you (after the read of the unlock flag, for a `ulocked` door from outside the bank)
later: `disappear` to clients near your old position
`player` to you, twice (the second is the full one)
Cave door: later: `new_map` and `player` to you (a door to `main`: `cave` `ended` first)
